title: Kimberly HA NDE 133
content: The seizure could've been fatal. I was in high school at the time of the 'blessed event'. I had just finished running the six hundred yard dash. What I didn't know was that my parathyroid gland was fluctuating, and so the exertion caused my body to go into a hypocalc'mia seizure. All of the muscles in my body began to cramp and draw up, including my eyelids. I buckled into a fetal position and fell down on the stadium steps. I knew that I was dying as I began to rise out of my body. I had a sensation like someone pulling a film strip through a viewer very fast. I experienced every color, every emotion of my life as it went by in a blur. I flew up very fast. I was literally flying through outer space. I passed literal planets. I wasn't sure where I was going, but I knew the way. I was aware of someone following behind me, but I didn't look back at them. They felt familiar. It was wonderful to move without effort. I arrived at my destination quickly. I was in a rectangular room. It was white, almost as if it were made of light. A man came through a door at the far end of the room to meet me. We were each like silhouettes inside of impossibly bright lights. I couldn't exactly see features on the man, but somehow I knew that he was male and older. He seemed vaguely familiar. He asked me to wait there and he left through the same door. After a moment, he returned and said, 'You have to go back. You still have a purpose.' I was very distressed and didn't want to leave this wonderful state, but suddenly I was flying back the way I came. I saw the earth, and the continent and the stadium as I shot very quickly down towards it. Then I saw my body lying on the ground. I slammed into it and there was a sensation like a hard impact. My eyes flew open for a second and I saw a large man squatting over me. I was startled because I hadn't seen him during my descent. Once again, I was unable to move or even open my eyes. The guy was startled as well. He jumped up and ran off. I could hear him yelling for someone to call an ambulance. I noticed that I could hear my brain screaming 'No, no, no ...!' just as it was before I left my body. While I had been 'out' it had been blissfully quiet. The guy came back and started trying to pry my arms away from my body, but my muscles where locked. I couldn't speak or make any noise. The ambulance arrived. They couldn't find any pulse on me at first, which frightened me since I could hear them. They said, maybe I was dead, but the guy told them that he'd seen my eyes fly open. They kept trying, and eventually found my pulse. My limbs became warmer and looser. They were able to pull my limbs away from my body, and I could once again open my eyes. But I see things a little differently since that day. P.S. One of the most unbelievable things about this experience is that the 'squatting man' turned out to be a celebrity himself. It was Jackie Slatter, a veteran player on the Los Angeles Rams football team. He just happened to be running in that stadium that day and exited out the same stair case that I collapsed on. Later I was able to meet him and thank him for his help. He said that my lips were blue and my limbs completely stiff when he found me.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Rising out of body; flying rapidly; moving without effort; described as wonderful.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A sensation like someone pulling a film strip through a viewer very fast; then flying through outer space past planets.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Flying through outer space; passing literal planets.

arrival.other_being_detail: A vaguely familiar older male who appeared as a silhouette inside an impossibly bright light; he came through a door, told her to wait, then returned and said, 'You have to go back. You still have a purpose.' Also sensed someone following behind her who felt familiar.

environment.environment_other_detail: Rectangular white room, 'almost as if it were made of light,' with a door at the far end.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told: 'You have to go back. You still have a purpose.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hypocalcemia seizure after running a six hundred yard dash; parathyroid gland fluctuation; collapse on stadium steps.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Life review described as a fast 'film strip' of 'every color, every emotion of my life' in a blur; travel through outer space past planets; saw Earth/continent/stadium on return; saw body and 'slammed into it.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Instead of a tunnel, she described rapid movement like a film strip and flying through outer space past planets before arriving in a bright rectangular room.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Travel described as flying through outer space past literal planets; return included seeing Earth, continent, and the stadium as she shot down. Post-return veridical element: a 'squatting man' over her later identified as Jackie Slatter of the Los Angeles Rams.
